text: 'Shark with blue shoes': concept art, 1 designs to choose from, then up to 1 rounds of notes

concept: A LEGO model of a chunky, stylised shark standing upright on two short legs, wearing oversized blue LEGO shoes, with a rounded grey body and small triangular fin details. (changed: Changed swimming pose to a calm standing pose on two stud-built legs so it can stand upright with shoes visible; Made the shoes chunky blocky bricks instead of soft rounded sneaker shapes, since the system builds from bricks and plates)
drawing the concept as an official LEGO set
reading the concept and writing the build brief
comparing the renders with the concept

score 3/10: Head is disproportionately huge and detached-looking, floating over a tiny body; No recognizable shark silhouette at a glance - reads as a random grey blob; Teeth rendered as round white studs/cylinders instead of pointed jagged teeth
reworking the design from the critic's notes
